posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
By this point we've collected a lot of people on the Letters Page who've decided to have some RPing fun with their questions, so let's discuss! Which personalities are your favorites? What do you headcanon the backstories of the various personalities as being? Any speculation on which regulars, if any, might be responsible for any of the personalities?

Personally I kinda want to join the Cult of Gloom. They seem rather personable and persuasive, and it's certainly true that it's better to owe your soul to the Cult of Gloom than to Matt, I say.
